descripcion: A first-person found-footage horror FMV game across five chapters. Answer the riddles. Complete the rituals. Satisfy the cult. Eight endings are waiting. Most of them are not escape.

A 2D roguelike where ink and plants define your fate. Combine skills, relics, and plant abilities to craft a unique build every run. Purify the Void Ink threatening to consume the world — because no two runs, and no two strategies, are ever the same.
generos: Acción | Aventura | Casual | Indie | Acceso anticipado

descripcion: Falta un mes para el Festival Tanuki y el santuario está en mal estado. Sigue a Pon, el tanuki bonachón y perezoso que trabaja a media jornada en correos y ayúdalo a rehabilitarlo antes de que acabe el verano. ¡Entrega paquetes, haz amistades y acondiciona el santuario para el gran festival!

nombre: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
descripcion: ¡Gestiona tu propia tienda de cartas de fútbol! Abre sobres para descubrir cartas raras de futbolistas, llena tus estanterías con productos de fútbol, vende a tus clientes, amplía tu tienda y conviértete en el propietario de la mejor tienda de cartas de fútbol.
generos: Casual | Indie | Simuladores | Deportes | Estrategia | Free to Play

nombre: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
descripcion: Te has muerto esperando el metro y una diosa te ha reencarnado en hormiga de medio centímetro. Su único encargo: llevarte una barra de pan de 72 cm entera, miga a miga, por una grieta de 9 mm, sin que te pille el Humano. Son 7.600 migas. Empieza por una.

Up to 100 million stones, one tiny toy shovel and one hidden diamond. Dig, haul and sell stones to afford better gear in this absurd first-person incremental game. Start with a yellow plastic shovel. The diamond could be in your very first successful scoop.

The noon bell hasn't rung. The king died without an heir. You're a wandering sellsword. Swipe left or right through a dark fantasy roguelite. Take a house's coin, buy a tavern rumor, or nurse an old wound for a day. Your choices shape the events and endings ahead.

nombre: TORAWASE: The Girl in the Mirror
descripcion: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

Explore an office swallowed by darkness with only a camera to guide you, photographing and reporting traces of spirits in this short psychological horror game. Use flash and night vision to uncover anomalies. But not every anomaly is something you should photograph.

¿Qué piensan realmente tus amigos de ti? Vota en este caótico juego cooperativo de fiesta con preguntas positivas y negativas de lo más divertidas. Sigue a la mayoría para ganar puntos y enfréntate a la prueba definitiva de la amistad. ¿Serás el genio del grupo o un desastre andante?
Tactics: Setting Sun es un juego de estrategia por turnos ambientado en el teatro de operaciones del Pacífico de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Equipa y dirige a tus tropas como mejor te parezca.

nombre: Tamzin Twins: The Tyranny of Tyrek
descripcion: Un RPG de acción épico con modo cooperativo local. En su camino hacia la venganza, Enya y Kyra lanzarán espadas, lanzarán hechizos, derrotarán ejércitos y se convertirán en heroínas.

A turn-based RPG about a pair of demons fighting to overthrow an unjust regime. Battle through the crumbling remains of Hell, God's forgotten penal colony, on a quest to find the Apple of Enlightenment and bring justice to the wrongly damned.

TaskFall es un juego de destrucción cooperativo basado en la física. Cumple misiones, sobrevive a desastres, cumple tareas de riesgo, Compra objetos y descubre los misterios mientras escapas del lugar. ¿Podras sobrevivir?

Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.
generos: Casual | Indie | Simuladores | Estrategia | Free to Play

descripcion: Abre tu tienda de informática en este juego de simulación y gestión: organiza los estantes, pide productos, fija precios y atiende la caja. Contrata empleados y prepara pedidos online mientras haces crecer tu negocio.

Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure Zelda-like with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...
An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

A co-op VR horror game. You're a gorilla trapped in Primal Dynamics' abandoned test facilities, and the monsters know you're here. Climb, run and hide through mazes, sewers and the backrooms with your friends, or become the monster in Monster Hunt.

A calm, craft-first jigsaw game. Feel every piece: seven interlocking cut styles across four board shapes, including grid, hexagonal, triangular, and organic Voronoi, from a few dozen pieces to 1,000+. Daily puzzles, shareable codes, and curated museum masterworks.

The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.

The Abyss’s Last Breath mezcla supervivencia, escape room y simulación inmersiva en una experiencia de terror psicológico única. Controlas a John, el único voluntario de una misión secreta destinada a descender hasta el borde del núcleo terrestre.

Una cómica aventura gráfica 2D de investigación dibujada a mano. En el papel de Tango Río, explorarás un archipiélago tropical, conocerás a extraños personajes y reunirás pistas resolviendo puzles en un juego clásico de apuntar y hacer clic, en busca de un padre que ha desaparecido misteriosamente.

The Ant Game is a real-time colony sim. You live in the dirt as a single ant while a whole colony runs around you: foraging by scent, digging its own nest, raising brood, and fighting beetles, spiders and rival colonies for the same patch of meadow.

descripcion: Abre sobres, encuentra variantes raras y convierte tu colección en una fuente de oro. Desarrolla tu ciudad y crea poderosas combinaciones en este juego idle de colección de cartas. Quizá algún día descubras tu verdadero objetivo…

Un juego incremental en el que tú eres el tornado. Arrasa campos, coches y edificios, cobra por los destrozos e invierte en un enorme árbol de habilidades. Crece y vuelve a por ese granero que se te resiste.
In a city near the mountains The Bull of Heaven is unleashed, tearing a wound in the world. A vivid action-rhythm game.

Un oscuro juego de inspección teológica en el que examinas fragmentos de las Escrituras introducidos de contrabando, comparas versículos, descubres pasajes alterados o inventados y decides qué debe formar parte de la Biblia que está reconstruyendo la resistencia.

Compra barato, regatea duro, vende caro. Dirige un negocio de coches de segunda mano donde cada coche esconde un pasado y cada cliente regatea a su manera. Inspecciona, repara, pon tu precio y pasa de un garaje callejero vacío a un showroom premium.

El Trono de Cinder es un RPG Idler donde matas pasivamente a los enemigos, subes de nivel, saqueas enemigos, cambias piezas de equipo y encuentras hechizos. Crea poderosas sinergias. Renace y regresa más fuerte.

A take on a more realistic city simulation experience. Control everything from the price of services, tickets, to how the city operates and runs. It's an experience that will continue to receive daily and weekly updates while in early release.

nombre: The Clock the Queen and the Door on the Beach
descripcion: A first person adventure about helping an inventor start a very unusual and untested reactor, to save a distant civilization. You explore the island, find clues in the environment, and make progress by solving simple, but interconnected and layered puzzles ( see main description for more ). No AI.

nombre: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
descripcion: ¡Salva a las tortugas y devuelve la vida a la playa! El verano ha terminado y los visitantes han dejado todo hecho un desastre. Recoge y clasifica basura, mejora tus herramientas y restaura el arrecife de coral en este relajante juego de limpieza, a solas o con amigos.

nombre: The Crane Files: A Detective Mystery
descripcion: A murder mystery deduction game. Investigate ten 3D crime scenes, question the suspects, collect clues as words, then fill in exactly what happened. Every answer needs evidence. And someone leaves a paper crane at every scene.

The Curator es un roguelite de gestión de galería de arte. Organiza obras, activa habilidades, completa desafíos para obtener mejoras, sube de nivel y satisface a visitantes exigentes. Desbloquea eventos de ciudad, artistas, libros y herramientas para crear builds únicos.

Has perdido tu alma en una partida de póker con el Diablo. Ahora, en las profundidades del Infierno, solo te queda luchar por recuperar la libertad. Te enfrentarás a una gran variedad de enemigos monstruosos en duelos de póker casi imposibles. Por suerte, haces trampas.

Estrella del fútbol el sábado, amañador de partidos el resto de la semana. Amaña partidos para el sindicato, compra al árbitro y evita que tu sospecha llegue a 100. Demo gratuita: juega tus 10 primeras semanas y la partida continúa en el juego completo.

nombre: The Great Sassanelli – An Interactive Novel
descripcion: A war of unseen ferocity is ravaging the continent. You, ringmaster dilettante, must keep the circus afloat. Travel, entertain, and keep the troupe’s spirits up while trying to find a mythical safe haven to last out the storm in this beautifully illustrated, text-based narrative adventure.

Un RPG de acción cooperativo extremo en pixel art, online o 4 en el mismo sofá. Esquiva jefes bullet hell, persigue únicos y equipo de 6 enlaces y forja a tu héroe en un enorme árbol pasivo. Cada héroe tiene una sola vida. Tu familia conserva el resto: sus habilidades, su banco y su Legado.

Investigue os recantos mais profundos da dark web neste jogo de terror psicológico e mistério. Analise arquivos, decifre terminais e desvenda segredos perturbadores numa atmosfera tensa e imersiva. Cada clique aproxima-o do desconhecido.

Of all man's mistakes none compares to The Horror. Tremble in its presence, panic, struggle, scream. Nothing will prepare you for the horror of The Horror. A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross multiple maps and modes.

You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

nombre: The House Dreams Along With Them
descripcion: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.
a Train has been infected with mysterious anomalies. G.O.A.B has secretly hired you to inspect the train. It's your job to find the anomalies and terminate them.

The Last Helm es una simulación de comercio y gestión donde construyes y diriges tu propia tienda en un mundo de fantasía. Empieza de cero, compra mercancías, fabrica armas y pociones, contrata empleados y organiza expediciones para expandir tu negocio.

One tree. An entire ecosystem to grow. Build your defenses, unleash spores and summoned allies, and survive relentless waves of pests in this incremental defense game. Earn permanent upgrades and help the last tree grow stronger with every cycle.

A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through biplanes, pterosaurs and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.
The shadow wants to play with you. It moves quickly, and you have to find it. Be patient, but don't wait too long. Light will be your friend. Don't make the shadow angry.

nombre: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
descripcion: France, 1940. Follow a Polish-Jewish family as Nazi occupation transforms their lives. Experience their story through the choices, struggles, and everyday moments that reveal the human cost of the Holocaust. A free narrative game.

descripcion: Lost in a living forest maze, armed with little more than a pistol. Hunt for the lost wanderer through ever-shifting paths. Fight off hostile wanderers, gather gems and keys, and unlock ancient doors. Every maze is new, and every run is a fresh path through the trees.

Con una sola linterna como apoyo, consigue tu objetivo en una fábrica sumida en la oscuridad y escapa sin que te vea 'Él', que deambula por la fábrica al azar. Supera el miedo extremo a lo desconocido que provoca la oscuridad y cumple tu misión a salvo.
The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

nombre: The Secret Society: Aventura de objetos ocultos
descripcion: Descubre objetos ocultos, resuelve puzles ingeniosos y explora mundos mágicos conforme investigas la misteriosa desaparición de tu tío.

The Smiling Flesh es un tenso survival horror en solitario. Infíltrate en una decadente mansión gótica, resuelve puzles y burla a una entidad aterradora que aprende tus movimientos. Encuentra el tesoro o conviértete en la próxima víctima de la mansión.

The dawn has been stolen! Take it back in a pixel-art action platformer where clever puzzles meet charged bow shots. Journey through eight biomes in Story Mode, or chase your next high score in an ever-changing Endless Mode.

Un juego casual de Texas Hold’em con desafíos en solitario y partidas online para 2–8 jugadores en Steam. Un solo pago, sin necesidad de comprar fichas. Todas las fichas son virtuales y no tienen valor monetario real.
Awaken aboard a silent orbital research station. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover the crew's fate, and survive the growing influence of ARGUS, the station's ever-watchful AI.

Construye tu propia bodega, elabora vinos excepcionales y haz crecer tu reputación con cada cosecha. Desbloquea recetas, domina nuevas tecnologías, organiza eventos en tu bodega y supera cada estación, porque la buena vinificación es un arte, y cada botella cuenta su propia historia.

Versión moderna de los juegos de construcción de ciudades clásicos, Theos: Cities of Myth te permite desarrollar una próspera metrópolis dedicada a una de las 7 deidades griegas. Erige un imponente santuario, satisface las necesidades de tus ciudadanos y funda una ciudad digna de los dioses.

Rompe contenedores. Hazte con el oro. Encuentra las llaves ocultas antes de que se acabe el tiempo. Recluta una banda de ladrones y vuelve a robar al señor en este breve juego incremental de atracos medievales.

An unfolding apocalypse will challenge your decision making as you try to keep the residents of the third floor happy and alive. Will they succumb to infighting? Or will you maintain the humanity of this small community?

nombre: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup
descripcion: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.

Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

3.888 huevos. Un gallinero acogedor. Muchísimo trabajo de clasificación. Ordena y organiza una variedad increíble de huevos monísimos, divertidos y maravillosamente raros. Pero ten cuidado con lo que rompas… ¡el gallo tiene algo que decir al respecto!

nombre: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
descripcion: Juego cozy de ordenar en primera persona. Devuelve 4.800 pergaminos de 21 alfabetos antiguos reales a las baldas de la Biblioteca de Alejandría, donde cada gato quiere un juguete: ¡encuéntralo para conseguir el pergamino que guarda! ¡Juega solo o con amigos online y a pantalla partida!

Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

《Tiny Village》 es un juego incremental en el que recolectas recursos con el ratón, desbloqueas nuevos edificios con los recursos que reúnes y desarrollas tu aldea. Mejora tus habilidades de recolección, desbloquea una gran variedad de edificios uno a uno y haz prosperar tu pequeña aldea.

TinyBriks es un relajante juego minimalista de construcción con piezas de plástico: sin objetivos, sin instrucciones, sin prisas y sin accionistas que contentar. Construye lo que TÚ quieras. Crea dioramas fantásticos con piezas de mil estilos y colores. El único límite es tu imaginación.
Un idle clicker en el que juegas en 16 tableros de ajedrez a la vez. ¿Sabes jugar al ajedrez? Aquí no hace falta.

Toadled: Eating Frenzy is an action roguelike with an appetite! Play as a toad and eat everything on your path to grow bigger and mutate into new, disgusting forms. Consuming human flesh? Fair game. Police cars, tanks, missiles? Mild indigestion. Try out hundreds of appetizing build combinations!

nombre: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
descripcion: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

Grab the Ember and RUN! An up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

Lead over 3400 soldiers in massive real-time battles across a vast 16th-century world from Europe to Japan. Conquer cities, recruit famous historical figures, and forge your empire in a grand sandbox RPG

Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

Townworks is a friendly crafting town builder: design the machines, place your blueprints, and grow a riverside hamlet from crates to home computers. Draw a workshop by hand, belt by belt and arm by arm, then build it all over town.
Build a squad of toys, stack buffs, and chain game-breaking combos in this roguelite auto battler. Unlock something new each run, endless synergies awaits — break the game!
Gestiona tu propia tienda en un simulador de comercio en primera persona donde compras barato, negocias buenos tratos y vendes con ganancias.

Conviértete en un maestro del tráfico con tus diseños de infraestructuras. Traza calles, da forma a los cruces, ajusta los semáforos, crea una red de transporte público y mira cómo la ciudad cobra vida. Crece por sí sola y cada edificio nuevo suma más viajes a las carreteras que has construido.
Trap Testers es un juego cooperativo de deathrun basado en físicas en el que tú colocas las trampas. ¡Compite contra tus amigos para llegar primero a la meta e intenta matarlos por el camino!

Endulza la cuenta atrás para Navidad con este fabuloso calendario de Adviento lleno de gatos escondidos que encontrar en este relajante juego de objetos ocultos para toda la familia de Travellin Cats, ¡los creadores originales del juego viral Hidden Cats!
A minimalist logic puzzle played on a 3×3 grid. Take on 200+ puzzles built around simple rules and intuitive controls.

Defiende tus puntos, róbaselos a tus amigos y cuela una respuesta falsa. Trivia Mayhem es un juego de preguntas para hasta 8 jugadores en línea, con multijugador local y bots. Preguntas a montones, 27 temas y giros que pueden cambiar la partida.

Enfréntate a dilemas imposibles, conoce a personajes de lo más extraños y descubre cómo cada cambio de agujas altera la historia. El tranvía no se detiene: tus decisiones marcarán en quién confías, a quién traicionas y si acabas siendo alguien que nunca quisiste ser.
Estamos en 2005 y estás a punto de construir la plataforma de intercambio de vídeos que cambiará el mundo. ¿Traerás la Edad de Oro de la humanidad o la pondrás de rodillas?

Farkle con runas encantadas. Lanza seis dados, asegura tus puntos o tienta a la suerte, e invoca la piedra rúnica que remonta una tirada perdida. Enfréntate a 12 parroquianos de la taberna, supera el desafío roguelite o pasa los dados a un amigo en la misma pantalla.

Tung Tung Tung Together is a co-op (1–4 players) survival horror set 10 years after Tung Tung Tung Survival. On the 1 km × 1 km Little Sahur Island, find items to repair your boat and escape while being hunted by the relentless Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.
Type in commands with your keyboard to guide a lost baby lizard through wild platforming challenges and reunite it with its mama.
Learn touch typing, shoot letters and play music pieces with your keystrokes! Competitive online typing game!
The world is your playground, experiment to learn how it works. Tzelem (צֶלֶם) is an action dungeon-crawler, where you use cards to change the world, your weapon and yourself.
Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

UFO98 es un juego de simulación incremental retro desarrollado en un escritorio de Win98 aislado. Descifra señales alienígenas encriptadas, filtra archivos ultrasecretos y desafía a un gobierno opresor para despertar a la humanidad a la verdad.

Ultimate RPS Championship turns Rock, Paper, Scissors into a full-blown 90s arcade combat sport. Build a deck of specialized moves, read your opponents, customize your fighter, conquer the story campaign, and take your strategy into PvP (coming soon).

Action survival carpentry. Nail anything to anything: drag, nail and build with a physics based barricading system to hold off the horde. A combat focused zombie survival experience for 1-4 players in online co-op.

Create your alien and hurl, smash, and blast your way through humanity! Mix 10 weapons with 8 origins, complete randomized missions, collect powerful upgrades, and grow stronger. Build your own playstyle in this action game with light ARPG elements.

A village of farmers is in trouble... A rageful and salty wizard, a huge rotten cake and a mouse as hero? Yes, you'll find all of these inside Unpredictable Cake, a 3D platform game where the main character is a mouse and the other characters are even more strange.

Inspired by true events. A suspicious disappearance at Stillwater Lake is quickly ruled an accident. Relying on scattered notes and your radio, explore the restricted zones to uncover her final hours. You must survive a ruthless local cult determined to keep their dark secrets hidden.
Urban Float is an endless 2D pixel-art platformer set in a city atmosphere. Use simple controls and precise timing to dodge obstacles, collect strawberries, and beat your highest score.

A simple but addictive isometric mining game, get upgrades, forge pickaxes, and travel deeper into the mines.

VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

Un roguelike de automatización donde una run cabe en una sesión. Coloca losetas hexagonales para hacer crecer un organismo de producción mientras la demanda de recursos sube. Tira dados en la tienda para comprar losetas, elige perks que cambian las reglas e intenta romper la economía por completo.

A first-person business sim about keeping a growing network of vending machines profitable. Start with $4,000, a tired van and one snack machine, then drive around Millbrook restocking, repairing and haggling over leases. Up to four players can share one company over a LAN.

Rompe el mundo y luego construye el tuyo. Vestalborne es un sandbox de acción y rol cooperativo con combate ágil, mazmorras profundas y fabricación infinita a través de muchas dimensiones. Mantén viva la Llama Eterna en solitario, con amigos o contra ellos.

Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

Build a new life on Grandpa Rıza’s farm in this cozy, single-player farming adventure. Grow crops, care for animals, fish, cook, craft, and fulfill your neighbors’ letters and orders on the way to the village fair.

descripcion: What the Buck?! es un juego incremental muy satisfactorio sobre destruir dinero. Tritura fajos de billetes, provoca reacciones en cadena por toda la mesa, haz prestigio para conseguir mejoras permanentes y automatiza tu destrucción de dinero. Tu progreso de la demo pasa al juego completo.

¡El hockey sobre hielo arcade se desmadra con 6 jugadores online y 4 en local! Embiste a tus amigos, esquiva ovnis y marca entre múltiples discos en cinco pistas impredecibles. Juega a solas contra bots o lleva a tu equipo del sofá a jugar online.

One shopping cart. Up to four players sharing the controls. Steer, jump and shoot through 10 hazardous stages and two boss battles in this co-op action game. Handle everything solo, or invite friends and find out whether your teamwork can survive without brakes.

En un mundo donde la superficie es inhabitable, la gente levantó sus reinos sobre las ramas del Árbol del Mundo. Ahora el árbol se derrumba, y un soldado emprende un descenso junto a una "niña maldita". Lee el viento, haz brotar flores donde aterrizar y ábrete camino hasta el suelo.

nombre: While Shifu's Away: Senior Sister, I've Fallen for You!
descripcion: Shifu is away, and your shy junior brother can no longer hide his feelings. Play as the senior sister in a sweet xianxia romance visual novel where replies and daily choices shape your bond and lead to different endings. And yes, the main characters sing original songs!

¡Sin votaciones ni reuniones: todos tienen poder de ejecución! Desenmascara a los impostores, protege a tu equipo y sobrevive en este juego de deducción social para 4-8 jugadores. Haz justicia con tu AK-47 multimodo. ¡Puro caos con chat de voz por proximidad integrado! 🔊💥

A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.
Supervivencia de hordas para un jugador con un toque de construcción incremental de bases. Partidas de ocho minutos. Ocho horas para completarlo.

Construye tu colmena y sobrevive en este simulador de colonias roguelike. Incuba abejas obreras, recolecta néctar y vende tu miel al mejor precio en un mercado hiperrealista. Vigila el clima de la colmena y repele los asaltos de avispas, o tu colonia se vendrá abajo. Levanta tu imperio de la miel.

Levanta tu hogar en una isla salvaje, en primera persona. Labra, siembra y riega tus campos, tala árboles para una cabaña de troncos y caza con arco en el bosque. Las estaciones cambian los precios del mercado, la lluvia riega por ti y los campos bien cuidados pueden dar cosechas de calidad oro.

Wildixir es un survivor roguelite de fantasía sobre una alquimia peligrosa. Combina hechizos automáticos, esquiva hordas cada vez mayores y convierte los santuarios purificados en arboledas curativas o jardines mortales. Desbloquea alquimistas y enfréntate a los jefes de tres tierras corrompidas.

Crash-land in a sci-fi survival craft game set on a planet plagued by toxic plasma storms. Alongside Bob, your sarcastic Virtual Sidekick, build and shrink your base to move it anywhere. Fight with primitive or plasma weapons, solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op!

descripcion: You start as a simple neutral Wisp. Absorb elemental motes, add elemental effects and strengthen your abilities, build your power, and survive a world that's already at war with itself. 12 elements. 11 abilities. 12 bosses. Permanent progression. Every run, a new chance.

You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

Domina el tiempo para controlar el movimiento de los objetos en este juego de puzles en tercera persona. Usa el paso del tiempo para llegar a lugares que antes eran inaccesibles. La recompensa que buscas te espera.

This is a fun 1-6 player asymmetric party game! Five player are mischievous troublemakers，hide among dozens of NPC students to sneak snacks, pass secret notes, and use phones secretly in class. One player acts as a strict teacher, track down all hidden troublemakers in the crowd.

Wretched es un juego táctico por turnos centrado en el posicionamiento estratégico, las combinaciones de habilidades y los ataques devastadores. Encarna a un ser ancestral de inmenso poder. Acércate, aleja a un enemigo de una patada y pasa detrás de otro. Encadena habilidades y aprovecha cada turno.

Atrapado en las profundidades por una excavadora rota, explora minas laberínticas para hallar piezas y escapar. Evita a una araña mecánica con trampas eléctricas o traiciona a tu equipo para quedarte el botín. ¿Lucharán juntos para sobrevivir o los dejarás atrás para llevártelo todo?

Construye una colonia en un mundo alienígena cubierto de hongos y mantenla con vida. Explora la niebla, expande tu territorio, explota la tierra y extermina a las manadas alienígenas antes de que lleguen a tu gente. Xenobiome Command no da tregua, del aterrizaje a la última resistencia.

Te perdiste en una mazmorra. Un crawler incremental basado en el buscaminas: despeja campos de minas, reúne modificadores, compra multiplicadores y haz que hasta las cifras más pequeñas den puntuaciones absurdas. El lugar está lleno de esqueletos, y algunos preferirían que no salieras nunca…

nombre: Your Suffering Is Important to Us
descripcion: Dirige una oficina corporativa en el Infierno. Contrata, personaliza y asigna impleados, rechaza a pecadores de poca monta, automatiza castigos absurdos y asciende por la jerarquía infernal en este cómico juego de gestión incremental.

Dive into Yuha's nightmares. Bear witness to a glitch apocalypse. Explore the hidden layers of a 3D-dreamscape. Piece together her memories and fears. Experience a true haunting with vanishing staircases, lost voices and time that keeps running out.

A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.
A Christian-themed, story driven, side scrolling platform video game in the ZJ the Ball franchise by Breakthrough Gaming!

TU CUERPO — TU DEBILIDAD. Un horror cooperativo para 4 jugadores que te pone en la piel de los científicos principales de un complejo de investigación. Tu único objetivo es ejecutar el plan de autodestrucción y abandonar las instalaciones.
Stare at a house. Question your life choices. This is Zen House: Zed Zero Simulator, the ultimate digital do-nothing simulator designed to waste your time and amplify your existential dread.
Después del colapso del Y2K, lleva tu taxi por el largo camino desde el Campamento Cero hacia el Sur. Recoge pasajeros, intercambia objetos y sobrevive al viaje.

descripcion: Zombie BBQ House es un simulador cooperativo online de restaurante para 1 a 8 jugadores. Detecta zombis disfrazados. Despieza, asa, sirve. ¿Golpeas a quien no es? Llega la policía. ¿Se quema? La cena te pega. ¿Ganaste dinero? Casino enfrente. Siempre hay uno que se escaquea y otro que busca líos.

An online co-op game for up to 4 players. Play as hamsters trapped in a huge scientific laboratory. Explore the lab, solve puzzles, and fight off enemies. Find a way out and unleash a true hamster apocalypse!

Swarm-scale tower defense: up to 40,000 aliens per siege, thousands on screen, physically crushing into your chokepoints. You are expected to fall — every kill banks credits, even in defeat. Grind the war economy, research deadlier guns, mount them on the ruins, and return to hold the line.
Pon a prueba tu sexto sentido. ¿Comerás un conejo salvaje o atarás a alguien a las vías del tren? Cada decisión depende de ti. Ojalá puedas reírte dentro de tus pesadillas.

nombre: a strange journey into the backrooms
descripcion: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

Domina el arte de conducir camiones en este simulador de física 2D con vista cenital ambientado en Italia. Navega por estrechas calles mediterráneas y perfecciona la geometría de tu aparcamiento. Relájate en el modo Zen o lleva tu precisión al límite en la modalidad Time Attack.

just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.
A (very) short incremental game where you blast shapes to solve computer problems. Put together a party of computer caretakers with their own unique skill trees and give the system a deep clean!
Face grotesque monsters in a dark, hand-drawn dice-building roguelike. Collect strange dice, stack modifiers, and build combinations that keep you alive through an endless series of turn-based duels.

Jugad juntos en un mismo PC u online a través de Steam. Para jugar online se necesita un chat de voz externo.
Today, you are a guest. So forget your troubles, take a sip of hot tea, and listen to a tale of an artifact that, according to legend, can manipulate time...
Try to find the “cat” hidden somewhere! If the “cat” is hard to find, you can color it in to make it easier to spot! Just find the “cat,” and the “Cat Encyclopedia” will be unlocked!

”ホロすと！ - Holo-Strike! -” is a stage-destruction, turn-based online co-op PvP game featuring VTubers from hololive. Choose your favorite character and aim for victory in intense 3v3 online network battles!

nombre: ムゲン階段 団地編
descripcion: A first-person psychological horror game set in an apartment stairwell looping from the 2nd to the 10th floor. Notice changes in doors, windows, and sounds, uncover the code, and find a way to the rooftop.

"The Nine Provinces" is an adventure-management text-based game. Set foot on the lands of the Nine Provinces, seek the ancient Nine Tripod Cauldrons, and encounter the moving tales that have been passed down through these realms. Different protagonists weave different stories.

Un juego de disparos vertical en pixel art con mejoras permanentes. Esquiva las balas, derriba enemigos y reúne recursos. Al volver a la base, mejora tu avión y desbloquea misiles, naves de apoyo y láseres para enfrentarte a 25 jefes con una potencia de fuego cada vez mayor.

Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.

This is an AI-driven story-driven strategy card RPG. In "Strange Three Kingdoms Simulator", you are not a spectator you are the one who rewrites the script. The Peach Garden Oath may not come to fruition, but if it fails to materialize, the course of the Three Kingdoms will be completely rewritten.
○学生の生意気な妹を調教するADVゲームがスチームで高画質化！

nombre: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
descripcion: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.
An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

nombre: 弾幕の戦乙女 -Barrage of Valhalla-
descripcion: A bullet-hell shoot 'em up meets hack-and-slash RPG. Become a valkyrie, weave through neon barrages under a sky of iron, hunt loot, forge gear, and fish, farm, cook between sorties. Can't dodge? Grind through it. Can? Chase top ranks. No stamina, no pay-to-win — buy once, play it all.
山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのは、正体不明の奇妙な4人の人物だった。聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る怖い話を楽しめます。VHS風画面短編集ホラーノベルゲーム。

A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

nombre: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
descripcion: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.
Explore Japanese scenery and culture through spot-the-difference puzzles, jigsaws, and sightseeing quizzes. Take your time with each view. The demo contains the first chapter set in Okayama.
正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，同时让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。

Defensa de torres con formación de equipos y cooperativo online. Recluta héroes, combina sinergias, forja equipo y elige dones celestiales. Distribuye tus recursos entre oleadas y defiende el paso entre dos mundos, en solitario o con amigos.

nombre: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
descripcion: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

Command Chinese troops in a 2D single-player real-time tactics game set during the 1937 Battle of Shanghai. Deploy infantry and heavy weapons, direct your defenses, and personally aim mortars as you face armored assaults, air raids, and amphibious landings.
desarrolladores: 重庆灵溪网络科技有限公司

nombre: 游戏发行模拟器 Game Launch Simulator
descripcion: GameLaunchSimulator is a text-based management sim about the full journey of publishing an indie game. Build your studio, plan new projects, prepare store pages, grow wishlists, handle reviews, release windows, publishing deals, and post-launch operations, then bring an unknown game to real players.

nombre: 灵能中介所 Ghost Hunting Journal
descripcion: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. Follow a duo of self-proclaimed “Spirit Agents” as they take on supernatural cases, use a range of ghost-hunting techniques, and investigate urban legends surrounding the lingering spirits of Riverrun.

Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.
desarrolladores: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD

descripcion: Collect yokai, capture pieces, and drain HP. Shogi-like moves plus damage and combos; matches last 5–10 minutes. Build a 50+ yokai roster and guard your general. Solo streaks in Night Parade, or online random match and room codes. Cross-play with the browser version. Free, no ads, no paid gacha.
A first-person exam simulator: pass by observing, remembering and deducing.

A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!
玩家将扮演一位刻薄的组长，从危险重重受到诅咒的公司里逃脱。在这里，不仅要躲避危险想办法完成10个“愿望”，还得小心那些针对你的、出乎意料的陷阱。

Una luz. Un paso. Un vuelo sin palabras. Hacia el vacío — no mires atrás.
Hold the line for the last 20 minutes. Open crates, upgrade and fuse 175 pieces of gear into a firepower network of your own. At minute 20, the final boss comes to grade your work.

Great Achievements is an online multiplayer role-playing game that takes you to an epic world filled with swords and magic. Choose multiple roles and form your own team. Explore the vast continent with friends, challenge legendary dungeons, and write your own adventure legends.

A fruit fly in a glass box on a windowsill. A small, slow game: place fruit, tap the glass and watch it walk, eat and take off, across 20 tasks. Its brain is a simplified model built from the published wiring map of a fly's central nervous system. All movements are assisted by code.

nombre: 降临之地 Realm of Advent
descripcion: Crea barajas únicas, desata combos demenciales con controles sencillos y mira cómo los números se disparan: te encantará Realm of Advent. En un mundo dominado por Apóstoles, combina 300+ cartas y reliquias para forjar sinergias adictivas y devastadoras.

High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

Como Aprendiz de Bruja, te enfrentarás a las dos examinadoras brujas Caperucita Roja y Alice en un duelo de cartas de examen, usando tu mazo básico, cartas de tesoro, habilidades pasivas y adivinación. Debes superar 10 niveles para convertirte en una bruja oficial.

Hacker Plan is a realistic hacking simulator. Ever dreamed of becoming a hacker? It all starts with your first command! In story missions, scout targets, crack passwords, bypass defenses and seize the entire network. No experience needed — just curiosity, and the game will make you a true hacker!

A single-player idle RPG with classic K-MMORPG spirit and no paid gacha. Switch between nostalgic and painted visuals, hunt manually or automatically, and grow through loot, crafting, equipment enhancement, and family progression.
